material: Lava stone, seven coloured stone beads, gold-tone metal spacers and charms

A bracelet of textured black lava stone beads, with a row of seven coloured beads representing the seven chakras, from violet to red. Gold-tone spacers, two studded cube beads, a pyramid bead and a hamsa hand charm complete the design.

The seven chakra colours come from the yogic tradition, where each colour is linked to one of the body's seven energy centres.

Care: keep away from water and perfume; wipe with a soft dry cloth.
